qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10 and IL-15/IL-21 with NK cell expansion
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 and IL-15/21 signaling with NK expansion
rationale: All members are IL-10, IL-12-family (IL-12/23/27/35) or IL-15/IL-21 signaling and the NK-cell differentiation/proliferation they drive, unlike confusables centred on type III interferon/IL-20, NKT cells or IL-2/7/9.

name: Trabecular and compact chamber myocardium morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern morphogenesis and development of ventricular and atrial myocardium (trabeculation, compact layer, chamber muscle growth), distinct from confusables on cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration, septation and heart-tube/second-heart-field, or endocardium and coronary vessels.

name: Eicosanoid and pro-resolving lipid mediator synthesis and signaling
rationale: Members cover synthesis, catabolism, transport and receptors of prostaglandins, leukotrienes, lipoxins, HETEs/EETs and resolvins/protectins/maresins, unlike confusables on coagulation/platelets, vitamin K, endocannabinoids or LPA receptors.

name: Stimulant drug reward and dopaminergic transmission
rationale: Members are behavioral/cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine and nicotine, conditioning, and dopamine release/transmission, distinguished from confusables on dopamine receptor signaling, opioid/neuropeptide signaling, ethanol, or social behaviors.

name: RUNX-regulated transcription and Hox gene clusters
rationale: Members are RUNX1/2/3 target-gene transcription programs (myeloid, BCR, WNT, interleukin, keratinocyte, estrogen receptor) plus Hox cluster gene sets, lacking the megakaryocyte/erythroid and granulopoiesis content of the confusables.

name: Postsynaptic dopamine receptor signaling and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor transduction routes (adenylate cyclase up/down, PLC, beta-arrestin) and their postsynaptic and locomotor/learning outputs, unlike confusables on dopamine release, drug-response behaviors or generic cAMP signaling.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling, cell density sensing and anoikis
rationale: Members concern Hippo pathway and YAP/TAZ transcription with density sensing, anoikis and growth-arrest/cell death outputs, distinct from confusables on senescence, TFAP2, PTK6 or TGF-beta receptor mutants.

qualifier: autophagosome maturation, lysosomal fusion, selective autophagy
name: Autophagosome maturation, lysosomal fusion and selective autophagy
rationale: Members cover autophagosome assembly/maturation, endosome/autophagosome-lysosome fusion and selective, micro- and chaperone-mediated autophagy, lacking the ESCRT/MVB, PINK1-Parkin mitochondrial dynamics or organelle-size content of confusables.

qualifier: glucagon receptor-cAMP-PKA and glucose-regulated insulin secretion
name: Glucagon-cAMP-PKA signaling and glucose-regulated insulin secretion
rationale: Members are glucagon receptor/adenylate cyclase/PKA signaling and nutrient (glucose, fatty acid) regulation of insulin secretion, unlike confusables on incretin, acetylcholine, adrenergic or FFAR-driven insulin secretion and gluconeogenesis.

name: Translesion synthesis and PCNA-dependent DNA polymerization
rationale: Members are polymerase-driven DNA synthesis steps in replication (priming, elongation, switching, flap removal), translesion bypass and NER gap filling, distinguished from confusables on base-excision gap filling, telomere C-strand synthesis, hypermutation or NER incision.

name: Skeletal myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: Members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, differentiation and fusion in muscle development and regeneration, unlike confusables on satellite-cell maintenance, negative muscle development or atrophy.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism
rationale: Members concern proline synthesis/catabolism, glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, distinct from confusables on urea cycle/arginine/ornithine or glutamate/glutamine metabolism.

name: Phospholipase C-IP3 calcium signaling and noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+
rationale: Members concern receptor-driven PLC activation, inositol phosphate production and calcium signaling including Wnt/Ca2+ and LPA receptors, unlike confusables on purinergic receptors, cAMP, PKC or eicosanoid GPCRs.

name: Oncogenic ALK, ERBB, FGFR and PDGFR variants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are cancer mutants, fusions and amplifications of ALK, ERBB2/EGFR, FGFR1-3 and PDGFRA/B and their inhibitor resistance, unlike confusables centred on KIT and FLT3 TKI resistance or EPO/STAT5 signaling.

name: TGF-beta/BMP/activin SMAD signaling and its cancer mutants
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling, its regulation and cancer-associated receptor/SMAD mutants, distinct from confusables on YAP/Hippo, MET or miRNA regulation.

name: RHOA/B/C, RHOD/F, RHOG GTPase cycles and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members are RHOA-D, RHOF and RHOG GTPase cycles with macropinocytosis, podosome and endosome transport, lacking the CDC42, RAC, RND, RHOU/V and actin-machinery content of confusables.

name: DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of damaged bases
rationale: All members are DNA glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines, distinct from confusables on defective glycosylase variants or downstream AP-site processing and gap filling.

qualifier: sterols, very-long-chain fatty acids, ether lipids
name: Sterol, very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are anabolic routes for cholesterol (Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell), fatty acid elongation and essential PUFA metabolism, plasmalogens and waxes, unlike confusables on mevalonate isoprenoids or peroxisomal beta-oxidation.

name: Thyroid hormone synthesis, action and peroxide generation
rationale: Members cover thyroid hormone generation (including the H2O2/ROS supply), transport, activity and receptor response, distinct from confusables on ascorbate, sulfate/iodide anion transport or selenium metabolism.

name: Enhancement of NK and T cell cytotoxic effector function
rationale: Members are NK cell signatures and positive regulation of NK/T cell cytotoxicity and NK cytokine production, unlike confusables on inhibitory KIR/MHC-Ib control, negative regulation or general T/NK modules.

name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport
rationale: Members concern red-cell O2/CO2/NO transport and Rh-glycoprotein-mediated ammonium transport, distinct from confusables on bicarbonate/carbonic anhydrase, Rh blood group biosynthesis or iron/heme handling.

core: Class I cytokine-type hormone receptor signaling
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling with IGF and body-growth regulation, unlike confusables on thyroid hormone, glucocorticoid or ghrelin/feeding control.

qualifier: HSF1 heat-shock response and mitochondrial import
name: Chaperone folding, HSF1 heat-shock response and mitochondrial import
rationale: Members cover chaperone/chaperonin folding and refolding, HSF1 heat-shock regulation and mitochondrial protein import/UPRmt, distinct from confusables on aggrephagy, nitrosative stress or stress granules.

name: Nitric oxide synthase activity and NO-cGMP signal transduction
rationale: All members concern NO synthase regulation and NO-mediated cGMP signal transduction, lacking the smooth muscle contraction and blood pressure outputs of the confusables.

name: Hedgehog ligand lipidation, autoprocessing and SMO-GLI signaling
rationale: Members cover Hh ligand autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release plus SMO activation, ciliary localization and GLI processing, distinct from confusables on Wnt/DVL, Wnt secretion or Notch.
